notes: New name: WallCAD. Your saved plans are kept.
Export DXF (AutoCAD) is now a full AutoCAD 2010 drawing: layers with colours, line types and weights, real hatches, real dimensions, and doors, windows and furniture as blocks.
3D of a part: tap 3D, then pick an area on the plan or use your selected walls. Or show the whole drawing.
In 3D, the ALL / PART button switches between the whole house and a part.
